 Match Preview
 UEFA Nations League B - Game Week 6 Nov 17, 2026 - 14:45 Tarczynski Arena Wroclaw Poland host Sweden at Tarczynski Arena in Wroclaw in UEFA Nations League B Group 4, with the table leaders arriving in Poland on the back of a strong run of form.
 Graham Potter's Sweden sit top of Group 4 and can seal promotion to Division A with a positive result. They head into this fixture having beaten Bosnia and Herzegovina 3-2 in their most recent Nations League outing, extending a campaign that has seen them win four of their last five group matches.
 Viktor Gyokeres has been central to Sweden's momentum. The Arsenal forward has scored in seven consecutive Nations League matches and enters this fixture with 25 goals in 41 senior appearances. He will be the primary threat Poland must contain.
 Jan Urban's Poland are in a difficult position. They have lost four of their last five matches across all competitions, including a 2-1 defeat to Romania in their most recent Nations League fixture. That result leaves them third in Group 4, with their campaign in serious danger of unravelling.
 Poland did beat Romania 6-0 earlier in this Nations League campaign, but that result now feels distant. Back-to-back defeats to Sweden and Bosnia and Herzegovina have dented confidence, and Urban needs a response on home soil.
 The two sides already met in this Nations League campaign, with Sweden winning 3-1 in Solna in September. Poland will need to reverse that result to keep any realistic hope of climbing the standings.
